links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT-4o prompt with no reading-level instruction (same questions submitted without limitations)
links.outcome: Response quality (accurate and complete) and reading level
links.effect: Default: 220 (77%) accurate and complete, 49 (17%) incomplete, 16 (6%) unacceptable; mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level 12.1 ± 2.1. Sixth-grade prompt: 242 (85%) accurate and complete, 38 (13%) incomplete, 5 (2%) unacceptable. Authors report the LLM can respond at a sixth-grade level without compromising quality.
links.quote: When asked to respond at a sixth-grade reading level, 242 (85%) responses were graded as accurate and complete, 38 (13%) were incomplete, and 5 (2%) were graded as unacceptable.
